name: 🫘 Black Bean & Sweet Potato Quesadillas
what: Creamy sweet potato and black beans with melty cheese, pan-crisped in tortillas.

core.name: Sweet potatoes
core.out: skip them and use more beans and cheese

extras: lime, cumin, chili powder, sour cream, salsa, avocado

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Poke the sweet potatoes and microwave until soft, turning once.
Scoop and mash with cumin, chili powder, salt and lime. Stir in the beans.
Spread on half of each tortilla, add cheese, fold.
Cook in a buttered pan over medium, pressing down, until golden. Keep finished ones warm at 250°F.
Cut in wedges. Sour cream, salsa and avocado on the side.

key: Microwave the sweet potatoes. Soft in 10 minutes, and the filling glues it all together.
done: Golden on both sides and the cheese is melted.
plan_b: Out of sweet potatoes? Plain cheese and bean quesadillas.
